stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition')

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "__start",NULL AS "__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","name" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition')

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source","attr","object",NULL AS "object_text" FROM (SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_id AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute')

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id",NULL AS "parent",NULL AS "edge_parent",NULL AS "kind",NULL AS "line",NULL AS "text",NULL AS "ordinal",NULL AS "parent_start",NULL AS "parent_end",NULL AS "parent_kind",NULL AS "ancestor_start",NULL AS "ancestor_end",NULL AS "ancestor_kind",NULL AS "name_id",NULL AS "name_source",NULL AS "function_id",NULL AS "function_start",NULL AS "function_end",NULL AS "function_kind",NULL AS "object_id",NULL AS "object_start",NULL AS "object_end",NULL AS "object_kind",NULL AS "object_source",NULL AS "attribute_id",NULL AS "attribute_source",NULL AS "callee_id","callee_kind",NULL AS "full_callee","callee","receiver" FROM (SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_id LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call')

stages.name: terminal_names
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","root","name" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE head(__path,root,node) AS (
        SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('call','attribute','identifier','as_pattern','parenthesized_expression')
        UNION ALL SELECT h.__path,h.root,c.id FROM head h JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=h.__path AND n.id=h.node JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id AND c.ordinal=0 WHERE n.kind IN ('as_pattern','parenthesized_expression')
        UNION ALL SELECT h.__path,h.root,n.function_id FROM head h JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=h.__path AND n.id=h.node WHERE n.kind='call')
        SELECT h.__path,h.root,coalesce(a.attr,n.text) name FROM head h JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=h.__path AND n.id=h.node LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=n.__path AND a.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('attribute','identifier'))

stages.name: authority_regions
stages.query: SELECT "__path",NULL AS "id","__start","__end" FROM (SELECT w.__path,w.id,w.__start,w.__end FROM nodes w WHERE w.kind='with_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes clause JOIN nodes item ON item.__path=clause.__path AND item.parent=clause.id JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=item.__path AND value.parent=item.id JOIN terminal_names t ON t.__path=value.__path AND t.root=value.id WHERE clause.__path=w.__path AND clause.parent=w.id AND clause.kind='with_clause' AND item.kind='with_item' AND t.name='explicit_execution_authority' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes attr WHERE attr.__path=value.__path AND attr.kind='attribute' AND attr.__start>=value.__start AND attr.__end<=value.__end)))

stages.name: peeled
stages.query: SELECT "__path","root","id","kind","text" FROM (WITH RECURSIVE peel(__path,root,id) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION ALL SELECT p.__path,p.root,c.id FROM peel p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.id JOIN nodes c ON c.__path=n.__path AND c.parent=n.id AND c.kind!='comment' WHERE n.kind IN ('type','type_parameter','parenthesized_expression') AND (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes s WHERE s.__path=n.__path AND s.parent=n.id AND s.kind!='comment')=1) SELECT p.__path,p.root,p.id,n.kind,n.text FROM peel p JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND n.id=p.id WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('type','type_parameter','parenthesized_expression'))

stages.name: subscripts
stages.query: SELECT "__path","id","__start","__end","name","argument","argument_kind","argument_text" FROM (SELECT g.__path,g.id,g.__start,g.__end,h.text name,p.id argument,p.kind argument_kind,p.text argument_text FROM nodes g JOIN nodes head ON head.__path=g.__path AND head.parent=g.id AND head.ordinal=0 JOIN peeled h ON h.__path=head.__path AND h.root=head.id JOIN nodes sub ON sub.__path=g.__path AND sub.parent=g.id AND sub.ordinal=1 JOIN peeled p ON p.__path=sub.__path AND p.root=sub.id WHERE g.kind IN ('generic_type','subscript') AND h.kind='identifier' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes sibling WHERE sibling.__path=g.__path AND sibling.parent=g.id AND sibling.kind!='comment')=2)

stages.name: bad_annotations
stages.query:
SELECT "__path","id","rendered" FROM (SELECT __path,id,text rendered FROM nodes WHERE kind='identifier' AND text IN ('object','DatabaseRow') OR kind='none'
       UNION SELECT __path,id,'list[DatabaseRow]' FROM subscripts WHERE name='list' AND argument_kind='identifier' AND argument_text='DatabaseRow'
       UNION SELECT n.__path,n.id,'DatabaseRow | None' FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.parent=n.id AND l.ordinal=0 JOIN peeled lp ON lp.__path=l.__path AND lp.root=l.id JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.parent=n.id AND r.ordinal=1 JOIN peeled rp ON rp.__path=r.__path AND rp.root=r.id WHERE n.kind IN ('union_type','binary_operator') AND lp.kind='identifier' AND lp.text='DatabaseRow' AND rp.kind='none' AND rx_matches(substr(n.text,l.__end-n.__start+1,r.__start-l.__end),'\|'))

stages.name: diagnostics
stages.query: SELECT "__path","__start","__end","id","message" FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.__start,c.__end,c.id,'connection grammar lazy terminal call: '||c.callee message FROM calls c WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('_grammar_effect_lazy','_grammar_row_lazy','_grammar_rows_lazy','_grammar_value_lazy') UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.__start,c.__end,c.id,'ServerPlan '||c.callee||'() outside execution boundary' FROM calls c JOIN terminal_names r ON r.__path=c.__path AND r.root=c.receiver WHERE c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('execute','execute_async') AND (trim(lower(r.name),'_') IN ('plan','plan_executor') OR trim(lower(r.name),'_') GLOB '*plan') AND c.__path NOT IN ('impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l5150_fts_polyfill/searcher/sql_helpers.py','impl/common/l5200_sql_query/_read_ops.py','impl/common/l5200_sql_query/_write_ops.py','impl/doltdb/query.py','l2050_transaction/legacy_wrappers.py','l2050_transaction/single_intent_execution.py','l2070_batching/plan_flush_operation.py','l7000_versioned_schema/versioned_connection.py','l7800_versioned_merge/merge.py','l9750_graphql/executor.py','l9900_auto_api/sparql_router.py') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM authority_regions a WHERE a.__path=c.__path AND a.__start<=c.__start AND a.__end>=c.__end) UNION ALL SELECT a.__path,a.__start,a.__end,a.id,'step compile() reads ctx.'||a.attr FROM attributes a JOIN nodes object ON object.__path=a.__path AND object.id=a.object JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=a.__path AND o.id=a.id JOIN functions f ON f.__path=o.__path AND f.id=o.fn WHERE object.kind='identifier' AND object.text='ctx' AND f.name='compile' AND a.attr IN ('branch_id','materialized_pipeline','sql_connection','txn') UNION ALL SELECT f.__path,f.__start,f.__end,f.id,'SyncSqlConnection defines forbidden grammar terminal: '||f.name FROM functions f JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=f.__path AND o.id=f.id JOIN classes c ON c.__path=o.__path AND c.id=o.cls WHERE c.name='SyncSqlConnection' AND f.name IN ('_grammar_effect_lazy','_grammar_row_lazy','_grammar_rows_lazy','_grammar_value_lazy') UNION ALL SELECT s.__path,s.__start,s.__end,s.id,'untyped LazyResult['||a.rendered||']' FROM subscripts s JOIN bad_annotations a ON a.__path=s.__path AND a.id=s.argument WHERE s.name='LazyResult' AND rx_matches(s.__path,'^(?:impl/common/l2070_server_plan/|impl/common/l2200_sql_dialect/|impl/sqlite/|impl/postgres/|impl/mariadb/|impl/doltdb/|l7000_versioned_schema/|l7200_versioned_transactions/|l7800_versioned_merge/|l9750_graphql/|l9900_auto_api/)'))

relational.query: SELECT __path path,__start start_byte,__end end_byte,message issue,id identity,message FROM diagnostics d WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes n WHERE n.__path=d.__path AND n.kind='module' AND rx_matches(n.text,'LazyResult|SyncSqlConnection|compile|execute|execute_async|explicit_execution_authority|grammar_lazy|legacy_async|legacy_sync')) AND NOT rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:tests|conform)(?:/|$)')
